steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（邀請碼 k8q4EoLk 已包含在連結中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (invite code k8q4EoLk is already part of it).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示註冊 VoiceTube，必要時下載 App。
steps.en: Register for VoiceTube as the page asks, and install the app if needed.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊完成後，開始用影片學英文。
steps.en: Once registered, start learning English with videos.

intro.zh-TW: VoiceTube 看影片學英語：用影片學英文，就像學母語一樣自然。
intro.en: VoiceTube: learn English through videos, as naturally as you learned your mother tongue.

description.zh-TW: VoiceTube 看影片學英語是用影片學習英文的服務，必要時也可安裝 App 使用。本站邀請連結已含邀請碼 k8q4EoLk，點擊「立即註冊」後依頁面指示完成註冊；若需手動輸入邀請碼，請依原樣（含大小寫）填入。實際的服務內容與規則以 VoiceTube 官方公告為準。註冊前請確認連結網域屬於 voice.tube 或 voicetube.com。
description.en: VoiceTube is a service for learning English through videos, and you can install its app if you need it. The invite link on this page already contains invite code k8q4EoLk, so after selecting “Sign up” you simply register as the page asks; if you need to type the invite code in, enter k8q4EoLk exactly as shown, including capitalization. The actual services and rules follow VoiceTube's official announcements. Before you register, check that the link's domain belongs to voice.tube or voicetube.com.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有說明邀請的獎勵內容，本站不列出優惠；實際內容以 VoiceTube 官方公告為準。手動輸入邀請碼時請依原樣（含大小寫）。
notes.en: The share text does not describe any reward, so none is listed here; VoiceTube's official announcements prevail. If you type the invite code in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.
